scientific_integrity: The symbol diagonalization is credited to prior literature; the proposed new statement concerns exact stationary-point counts, spectral multiplicity, strict global peak, and the asymptotic norm. Finite checker corroborates but does not certify infinite quantifiers.

title: The ninefold scale-gap transition in two-octave Cauchy-wavelet localization
